question: Which of the following is a pigment present in human blood that carries oxygen from our lungs to all parts of the body?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haemoglobin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hemoglobin is a pigment present in human blood that carries oxygen from our lungs to all parts of the body**__.
 
• **RBCs contain hemoglobin** a** protein that carries oxygen.**
